claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Bergenin is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent at 2.5 uM over 5 days; its reported activities are antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, PPARγ-mediated and NF-κB/MAPK modulatory, without potent cancer-cell-autonomous killing at this concentration.
